# Welcome to Solidatus *Build and explore interactive blueprints of* ***data lineage** across your entire organisation.* Our mission is to make fine-grained data lineage easy to capture, understand, and analyse, even for the largest, most complex and highly regulated organisations in the world. Explore all aspects of Solidatus using the cards below or the sidebar on the left. {% hint style="success" %} If you're building your first models, you might want to start by [importing model content](/get-started/import-model-content) or using our [connectors](/connectors/connectors-overview) to extract lineage and metadata from external systems. {% endhint %} ## Explore Solidatus

## Did you find what you need? * Get the basics under your belt with our [Quick-Start Guide](/get-started/quick-start-guide) * The [Learn Platform](https://learn.solidatus.com/) offers training courses to develop your skills * Our [Video Library](/get-started/video-library) contains links to short, helpful how-to videos * View our API overview documentation here: [Solidatus API](/api-documentation/api-overview) * Access [documentation for Solidatus administrators](/account-management/admin) ## Support & feedback The team is always happy to receive feedback and help with your support queries. Please contact your Solidatus coordinator directly, or email the Solidatus support team at [support@solidatus.com](mailto:support%40solidatus.com). If you need to share your model with the Solidatus support team, learn how at [Sharing with Solidatus Support](/additional-resources/advanced-topics/sharing-with-solidatus-support). ***
